data_to_hypothesis: Map dated markets, actual and published products, competition, fleet, existing obligations, costs and coverage gaps.
Identify a specific passenger problem or network opportunity supported by those inputs; an empty timetable record does not prove unmet demand.
Register a falsifiable hypothesis, mechanism, relevant markets, competing explanation, expected decision impact and distinguishing experiment.
Test feasible alternatives through the common engine; an unsupported critical input leads to sourced research, justified ranges or decision thresholds.
Update the active set as evidence arrives. Record new, revised, merged and superseded versions; never manufacture reasons to reject unfinished work.

parallel_investigation.unit: A coherent programme or matched alternatives for one city/market, including local data, competitors, resource and economics; split a broad branch when evidence justifies it.
parallel_investigation.dispatcher: coordinator; packages P07/P08/P08I describe work families and may have multiple centrally delegated instances
parallel_investigation.instance_brief_rule: At dispatch, the coordinator materialises a distinct task ID, variant/revision, pinned input versions and the unique work_scope_template in the actual brief. Family-level P07/P08/P08I scopes are aggregate outputs, not a shared write directory for parallel variant workers.
parallel_investigation.dispatch_rule: As pinned usable inputs become available, dispatch distinct variants in parallel. Keep enough capacity for shared data, engine and meaningful checks. No permanent city agent waiting idle and no fixed finalist quota.
parallel_investigation.coverage_rule: Every seed city gets an explicit applicability disposition; every active hypothesis gets a reasoned result or precise unresolved condition. Depth follows potential decision impact and real uncertainty, not a clock cutoff. All viable material variants are deepened; history may be merged or superseded.
parallel_investigation.hypothesis_updates: A worker proposes or revises hypotheses in its branch. The coordinator checks duplicates, records lineage and dispatches affected work; existing workers do not silently change shared inputs.
parallel_investigation.feedback: Variant result → shared comparison → identify the input or design difference that changes the decision → responsible data owner or variant → new pinned input/design → rerun affected alternatives. Data discoveries relevant to other branches are propagated through the coordinator.
parallel_investigation.independence: Variant research must seek counterevidence. Independent reviews remain fresh tasks with the existing author-exclusion rules.

joint_comparison.endogenous_differences: Itinerary quality, own sales migration, capacity, launch/base costs and explicitly modelled competitor reactions may differ by programme.
steps: Evaluate feasible individual programmes and matched alternatives under comparable resource constraints; unneeded resource may remain unused.
Generate combined hub/direct programmes using route and flight specifications, not the sum of stand-alone results.
Reassign shared fleet, dated seats and passenger choices; count fares, base costs, support, donors and reserves once.
Compare net additional traffic and revenue, full incremental result, funding and risks against same-period KEEP; retain non-dominated choices where preferences or budgets are unresolved.
Stress the fixed programme, then evaluate feasible adaptation and staged launch under the same scenario.
joint_comparison.output: Versioned programme × scenario × month table with resource, before/after network, traffic, economics, funding, uncertainty, traceable hypotheses and actions.
joint_comparison.subjective_tradeoffs: Keep every weight, proxy, estimated cost and range in the user assumption register. No hidden all-purpose winner score.
joint_comparison.limits: Best found programme is not a proof of global optimality; record search coverage and remaining decision-relevant gaps.
